column1: # The App Store screenshot set, one row per capture.
# Columns (tab-separated): device  index  name  link  anchor_by  anchor
#   device     matches a profile in capture.sh (iphone | ipad)
#   index      filename prefix; also the `n=` nonce on the deep link
#   name       filename stem — output is www/src/assets/screenshots/<device>/<index>-<name>.png
#   link       a dexter:// deep link; see src/utils/todayRoute.ts and ritualRoute.ts
#   anchor_by  id | text  — prefer id; a text anchor is compiled to a regex
#   anchor     the selector proving the screen rendered before we shoot it
# Every Today link carries an explicit `mode=` and a distinct `n=`. A bare
# `dexter://today` parses to a null link (parseDayLink) and reads as an ordinary
# tab press, which would leave the previous shot's backlog drawer open.
# Adding a screenshot is a row here, not a new flow file. Order is capture order.
# src/__tests__/screenshots/screensManifest.test.ts checks every link still parses.
